_chart: golden: 1995-04-29 18:00 Beijing, 乙亥 庚辰 庚寅 乙酉, Day Master 庚 strong, Overfueled, age 31 in 2026

units.where: Life Chapters · the title
units.text: You are in your Rising Chapter, in a Magistrate decade.

units.where: The Early Chapter · the Steward at the Year Gate · lived
units.text: Your Early Chapter was an orderly one, with money counted at home and promises kept in front of you. You came out of it careful, and the habits you formed then still run your accounts.

units.where: The Early Chapter · the Artisan inside the Year Gate · lived
units.text: Inside it ran a steady supply of comfort, good food and someone who made sure you were fed. You still trust that early ease, and you go back to it whenever life runs thin.

units.where: The Early Chapter · Sage decade 2003 to 2012 · weighed
units.text: These years gave you more looking after than you needed, and you learned to wait for permission before you moved.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · the Twin at the Month Gate · now
units.text: Your Rising Chapter is the one where you prove yourself alone. Since your late teens you have taken whole jobs and signed your name to them, and you trust what you carried yourself more than anything you were handed.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · the Alchemist inside the Month Gate · now
units.text: Beneath it runs a private education in things nobody asked you to learn. You are gathering the strange and specialist knowledge your later work is paid for, and you rarely explain it to anyone.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · Alchemist decade 2013 to 2022 · weighed
units.text: These years kept you studying and second-guessing longer than your friends, and you came out of them knowing more than you could yet use.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · Now · Magistrate decade 2023 to 2032 · helping
units.text: This decade gives your life a structure it did not have before, a clear role and people who rely on you to keep it. You take on more responsibility than you planned, and it steadies you more than it weighs on you.

units.where: The Home Chapter · the Horizon inside the Day Gate · coming, from 2030
units.text: Your Home Chapter opens wider than the ones before it, through a partner whose world is bigger than yours. From your mid-thirties your days fill with new people, side ventures and offers you did not go looking for. You will say yes more often in this chapter than in any other, and most of those yeses pay you back.

units.where: The Home Chapter · General decade 2033 to 2042 · helping
units.text: This decade brings pressure you can use, a hard deadline or a rival or a role with stakes, and you rise further under it than in any easy stretch.

units.where: The Late Chapter · the Steward at the Hour Gate · coming, from 2043
units.text: Your Late Chapter is the well-kept one, when the care of every earlier decade finally shows. From your late forties your days run on order and calm, and you are the person others call when something needs sorting out.

units.where: The Late Chapter · the Rival inside the Hour Gate · coming
units.text: Behind it, the people after you push against you and stand up for you in the same breath. You hold your own place in these years only where you fixed its size early.

units.where: The Late Chapter · Steward decade 2043 to 2052 · helping
units.text: This decade rewards patience with steady returns, and you build the kind of security that lets you stop counting.

units.where: The Late Chapter · Horizon decade 2053 to 2062 · helping
units.text: This decade opens side roads and second ventures, and you find money and company in places you had never looked.

units.where: The Late Chapter · Virtuoso decade 2063 to 2072 · helping
units.text: This decade gives your voice back its edge, and you say what you think with more freedom than you allowed yourself before.

units.where: The same seat for a reader aged 35 to 47 · now
units.text: Your Home Chapter is wider than the ones before it, opened by a partner whose world is bigger than yours. Since your mid-thirties your days have filled with new people, side ventures and offers you did not go looking for. You say yes more often now than in any earlier chapter, and most of those yeses pay you back.

units.where: The same seat for a reader past 48 · lived
units.text: Your Home Chapter was the widest of your life, opened by a partner whose world was bigger than yours. Those years filled with new people, side ventures and offers you never went looking for. You said yes more often then than at any other time, and much of what you have now came through those doors.

units.where: 2026 · a General year · now
units.text: A hard test arrives from outside, a demanding boss or a rival or a deadline you did not set. You meet it better than you expect, and people remember how you handled it.

units.where: 2026 · joins your Day Gate (寅午)
units.text: You make a decision about home or partnership this year that you have been circling for a while.

units.where: 2027 · a Magistrate year
units.text: A role with your name on it arrives, a promotion or a title or a formal promise. You accept more responsibility than you planned, and you are steadier for it by the end.

units.where: 2028 · an Alchemist year
units.text: Your attention turns inward, toward study and second thoughts and plans you keep to yourself. You get less done than you meant to, and you understand more at the end than at the start.

units.where: 2028 · clashes with your Day Gate (寅申)
units.text: You change something at home this year, an address or the way you share your life with a partner.

units.where: 2029 · a Sage year
units.text: Help and advice arrive in larger amounts than you asked for, from a teacher or an older ally. You lean on them longer than you need to, and you finish knowing which help to keep.

units.where: 2029 · binds with your Month Gate (辰酉)
units.text: You tie yourself to a workplace or a team this year more firmly than before, by contract or by loyalty.

units.where: 2030 · a Twin year · your Home Chapter opens
units.text: Your life fills with equals, a new colleague or a friend who wants exactly what you want. You compete more than you admit, and you come out of it more set in your own way.

units.where: 2030 · clashes with your Month Gate (辰戌)
units.text: You leave a role or a team you have outgrown this year, by your own choice or by theirs.

units.where: 2031 · a Rival year
units.text: Someone arrives who wants a share of what you have, at work or among friends. You give ground on money or credit before you notice, and you hold the rest only by being blunt.

units.where: 2031 · binds with your Day Gate (寅亥)
units.text: You draw a partner or a household closer this year, and the life you share takes on a firmer shape.

units.where: 2032 · an Artisan year
units.text: Your appetite comes back, for good food and for the work you enjoy making. Your work gets easier and better liked, and you finish with something you made that people keep.

units.where: 2032 · joins your Month Gate (子辰)
units.text: You gather people and momentum around one idea at work this year, and it carries further than you planned.

units.where: 1 · Your structure · a Steward structure (正财格)
units.text: Your chart is built around money kept and value earned. You do best when the work in front of you has a clear return, and you trust a slow sure gain over a fast one.

units.where: 1 · why this structure (the revealed-stem rule, 子平真诠)
units.text: The Wood hidden in your strongest seat shows on two of your stems. That makes the Steward the organising force of your life, and you answer to it more than to the Alchemist who holds the seat.

units.where: 1 · Formed, under strain
units.text: The Twin and the Rival stand close to your Stewards, and you keep losing a share of what you earn to equals.

units.where: 1 · what protects it · brought by your Magistrate decade 2023 to 2032 and General decade 2033 to 2042
units.text: Outside pressure protects it, a boss or a rule or a deadline, and you meet that pressure in your decades now and next.

units.where: 2 · Strongest
units.text: Wood and Earth carry two thirds of your chart, and you live mostly through what you earn and what you think.

units.where: 2 · Missing · no Magistrate · brought by your Magistrate decade 2023 to 2032
units.text: No Magistrate sits in your chart, and nobody inside it tells you what the rules are. You borrow structure from a boss or a contract, and you work best once someone else has fixed the terms.

units.where: 2 · Missing · no Sage · your Sage decade 2003 to 2012 is lived
units.text: Your chart holds no Sage, and nobody inside it shelters you or praises you for trying. You learned early to reassure yourself, and you trust help more when you did not have to ask for it.

units.where: 3 · In plain view · the Steward, twice
units.text: You come across as a careful provider, the one who pays on time and keeps count.

units.where: 3 · In plain view · the Twin
units.text: You come across as someone who carries their own weight and asks for little help.

units.where: 3 · Inside · the Artisan
units.text: You want comfort more than you show, good food and an evening with nothing planned.

units.where: 3 · Inside · the Alchemist
units.text: You think in strange directions and keep most of those thoughts to yourself.

units.where: 3 · Inside · the Horizon
units.text: You keep a second plan that nobody has heard about, and you want more open roads than you admit.

units.where: 3 · Inside · the Rival
units.text: You keep score with the people closest to you, and you want to win more than you let on.

units.where: 3 · the closing line
units.text: Only the people you live with meet the second list.

units.where: 4 · Peers beside the purse (比劫夺财)
units.text: Equals and money share your chart, and you lose most where you share most, with friends and family and partners.

units.where: 4 · Thinking starves making (枭神夺食)
units.text: Your thinking outweighs your making, and you study a thing so long that the moment to make it passes.

units.where: 4 · Day binds with Year (寅亥合)
units.text: You build your own home close to the habits of the one you grew up in, and you return to them more than you expected.

units.where: 4 · Month binds with Hour (辰酉合)
units.text: You carry the people and skills of your working years into your later life, and the circle you build now stays with you.

units.where: 4 · the closing line, when no clash, punishment or harm
units.text: No clashes, punishments or harms sit between your gates, and you argue with yourself less than most people do.
